# Prototype hybrid review

Paste this into **Rule Packs → New Pack**, or POST it to `/api/rule-packs`.

## Pump presence

The prepared diagram must include at least one CentrifugalPump.

## Isolation checklist

Confirm isolation valves are present around major equipment before trusting
engine outcomes.

## Fire relief adequacy

Relief capacity must be adequate for the worst-case fire scenario.
